turns.question: What was our best week between Monday 17 August and Sunday 27 September 2026, and what did it bring in?
turns.answer: Our best week in that window was Monday 21 to Sunday 27 September 2026, which brought in EUR 3,387.25 in revenue (gross, non-cancelled orders) over those 7 days. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
